# cd01: retain combat while occupying a completed camp

Base `2f0f534e8311ee597e516b11c2afca1bbf608060`; base bot `leader_party_tuned`.
Edit only `bots/pi_capture-defense-01/` and write IMPLEMENTATION.md. Independent

## Evidence and hypothesis

Official engine3 baseline against Fish, Sunburst match
`01a1a9b5-5820-7d5c-a12d-067b31912fb5`: our group7 clear completes23;
capture timer starts24 at5, falls to3 at26. Fish Heart dashes from(43,24)
to(45,23) at round26/input919, damages our Vendetta320 and immediately resets
capture. Fish eventually captures47. Same map/side/seed against Mite
`01a1aa37-e0c0-70c8-a4ef-95792ceed90d` has no contest and our capture completes29.

The official locally shipped visualizer WASM decodes these replays offline;
endpoints and native-summary clear/capture timestamps reconcile. At our Ren's
turn openings27/28/29 (inputs962/998/1044, substep7), Ren is alive at(47,22),
on a group7 spawn tile, no channel, restrictions0, no buffs, attack allowance
set. Official host attack mask includes adjacent Fish Vendetta at27, Vendetta
and Heart at28, Heart at29. The next action is End turn at963/999/1045; no
attack or cast. Ren has no fuel exhaustion on27–29. Opponent-source access is
neither available nor needed. These facts identify unused legal action windows;
they do not prove that fighting would have saved the objective or the game.

`Bot::camp_action()` currently returns immediately when a freshly observed
reward is available and self is on its tile, before any call to `fight()`.
The ordinary state/danger dispatcher has already run. Capturing requires
continued uncontested occupancy; attacking/casting without moving does not
itself vacate a capture tile. Existing `fight()` excludes offensive dash
selection and already guards channels, readiness and current-round fuel.

Hypothesis: allowing existing stationary enemy combat in this branch recovers
useful attacks/casts during reward occupation, without sacrificing occupancy.
This is an execution gap, not a new fight/retreat policy. Prevalence is not yet
established beyond the diagnostic; local screen must establish practical value.
Alternative causes remain stronger opponents, roster, retreat, and other fuel
pauses. Do not promise this isolated change beats Fish.

## Exact behavior

In the existing fresh reward-available/on-own-tile branch only:
if the existing snapshot has visible enemy champions, call
`fight(world, -1, true)` before returning. Return afterwards exactly as before.
Use the existing fight function; do not add movement, target scoring, defensive
casting, reachability loops, threat queries, telemetry or state machinery.
The `-1,true` call prevents camp targeting and uses existing enemy-only travel
combat. No enemy means retain the existing immediate return.

Leave all earlier danger/escape/recovery/channel priorities and all other
camp_action paths unchanged. No thresholds, draft, items, planner, navigation,
task lifetime, leadership, protection limits, or observation changes. Do not
implement contested-target pursuit or force a stay when the dispatcher escapes.
Check the actual existing ability kinds to substantiate stationary execution.

## Focused correctness

Exercise the actual production branch, using fake SDK/link stubs if necessary:
fresh cleared group+self on tile+visible enemy invokes existing enemy-only
combat once and makes no move/abandon call; enemy-free occupation makes no
combat call; living/unseen group and outside-tile paths preserve behavior.
Cover an unavailable/restricted/channeling actor through the real fight guards
or existing relevant tests, documenting any fake limitations. Verify no combat
is forced before the higher-priority escape/channel states. Do not merely test
a duplicated policy expression. Run available native tests and real-SDK syntax
checks; report actual results and gaps. Pi does not need to run engine matches.
